title: Meeting
description: A sitting of a government body: a council meeting, a committee hearing, a commission session.

@type.description: Use `EventSeries` for the recurring series, `Meeting` for one sitting - minted as a subclass of `schema:Event` because `Event` alone cannot distinguish a council meeting from a summer concert, and discovery depends on that distinction.

name.description: The meeting's title, e.g. 'City Council Regular Meeting'.

description.description: A plain-language summary of the meeting's purpose, when the name alone isn't enough.

url.description: Where this meeting's canonical human-readable page lives.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this meeting beyond its `@id`.

organizer.description: The `GovernmentOrganization` sitting. Required: a meeting with no body cannot be placed in the structure.

startDate.description: Use a full date-time with offset. A meeting time without an offset is ambiguous.

endDate.description: When the sitting adjourned, once known.

eventSchedule.description: For a series: a `schema:Schedule`. 'Second Wednesday of each month' is `byDay` Wednesday, `byMonthWeek` 2, `repeatFrequency` P1M - machine-readable, unlike a prose string.

eventStatus.description: Real schema.org `EventStatusType`. A cancelled meeting must stay published as cancelled, not disappear.

eventAttendanceMode.description: Whether the meeting is in person, online, or both.

previousStartDate.description: Required by schema.org semantics when `eventStatus` is `EventRescheduled`.

subEvent.description: Recesses or breakout sessions within this sitting, when published as their own entities.

agendaItem.description: The ordered business of the meeting.

isAccessibleForFree.description: Whether attending or viewing the meeting costs nothing.

inLanguage.description: The language(s) the meeting is conducted in.

maximumAttendeeCapacity.description: The venue's attendance limit, when relevant (a fire-code capacity, a webinar seat limit).

sourceDataset.description: The Dataset this record was published as part of.
